Position Summary

The Digital Delivery Specialist (DDS) is focused on the Building Information Modeling (BIM) portion of the Digital Delivery team and support for the design and project delivery process. The DDS will work at the direction of the Digital Delivery Director and will support the BIM workflows and digital design
methods and technologies. They also promote advancement of BIM methods and the implementation of digital design standards.

The DDS is part of the Digital Delivery team that will identify and resolve issues through close interaction with project BIM team members and collaborate on project management with the multiple design teams involved with model integration. They oversee the implementation of systems and tools and serve as subject matter experts providing knowledge and advice related to specific technological products or issues.

Typical Responsibilities

  • Coordinate with other DDS and BIM Coordinators to support the implementation of BIM technology.
    • Coordinate and monitor the effective implementation of BIM on projects across all offices.
    • Manage the implementation of supporting software applications for BIM and project delivery.
    • Stay abreast of new and emerging technologies and best practices impacting digital design to enhance productivity and efficiency.
    • Provide feedback to the Digital Delivery team on project-based activities.
    • Act as a resource and team member in all phases of the project.

• Manage content platforms (libraries)

  • Liaise with Digital Delivery specialists across the organization and third-party technology vendors.
    • Maintain and develop BIM-related content for design practice.
    • Document Digital Delivery processes, procedures, and workflows.
    • Coordinate with the IT group regarding any software and network support needed as it relates to BIM and project delivery.
    • Develop and administer BIM-related training programs.
    • Create help guides and other tech-related materials.
    • Review performance and progress on a regular basis and recommend improvements where applicable.
    • Ensures projects document processes, procedures and workflows for lessons learned information.
    • Research Interoperability Management between BIM and design / engineering tools
    • Proactive approach and learning of new technology software.
    • Drives Standards, processes & procedures.
    • Surveils project needs of integrating BIM and Information Technology
    • Ensures template project BIM execution plans adequately address project needs.
    • Understands BIM Industry Coordination / Collaboration practices.
    • Understands Clash-Detection, Communication, and resolution practices.
    • Provide Clash-detection session under the supervision of the PDDL.
    • Understands the issues with Multiple Design Models Coordination
    • Understands the BIM facility lifecycle.
    • Assists with leading BIM Coordination Meetings
    • Liaisons with BIM project staff in deploying project-template and surveilling projects applicability.
    • Occasional travel (<20%) to project locations, as needed.
    • Attend Vendor Conferences to disseminate knowledge and information to the extended Digital Community.
    • In campus/complex projects the PDDS participate at the IDR Workflow and provide markups
    to adhere with Graphic Standards Requirements.

Essential Job Duties

  • Assist project teams in BIM project set up and the development of BIM Execution Plans (BxP).
    • Assist integrated design teams to develop BIM workflows and strategies for effective collaboration on BIM projects.
    • Assist project teams with troubleshooting, model management and design as well as coordination issues.
    • Responsible for automation of processes and tasks using scripting and/or integrations with 3rd party tools.
    • Prepare workflows integrating other software with Revit® software for; user productivity, model coordination, analysis, data enrichment, rendering and animation.

Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

  • Advanced knowledge in building information modeling programs and applicable techniques.
    • Expertise in Revit/Navisworks required.
    • Multitasking: Ability to manage a variety of tasks in various stages of development.
    • Proficiency in MS Office Outlook, Word and Excel required.
    • Ability to effectively meet deadlines.
    • Proactivity: Acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the Digital Delivery Team.
    • Think strategically as well as provide subject matter expert knowledge and advice on highly
    technical issues. Possess an attitude to lead by example.
    • Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
  • 10+ years’ progressive experience in BIM/3D Modeling inclusive of 3+ years experience managing BIM Projects is required.
  • Bachelor Degree of Science in Architecture/Engineering is required.

TEECOM hires by discipline, not by open requisition. We are growing — multiple teams across the US, UK, and India are actively hiring to grow their teams.

When you apply here, you are applying to TEECOM for a role in BIM / Production. Rather than interviewing for a single posted role, you will go through a structured Discipline Assessment that establishes your level and demonstrated capability. Once your level is determined, TEECOM's recruiting and leadership teams match your profile to the best available opening on a team that fits your skills, experience, and goals.

Roles span Designer II through Senior BIM Specialist II. Your level — and your title — are determined by your assessment, not by the role you apply to.

If you have meaningful experience in more than one discipline, apply to your primary discipline and tell your recruiter about your secondary discipline(s) during your Introduction Call. You may be scheduled for a separate Discipline Assessment for each one.

BIM / Production at TEECOM

    TEECOM's BIM / Production practice is the backbone of how TEECOM delivers coordinated, construction-ready technology systems documents. BIM / Production specialists work alongside discipline engineers across ICT/Telecom, Security, AV, Wireless, Acoustics, and other technology disciplines to produce Revit models, coordinated drawings, and construction documentation.

    Work includes Revit modeling and coordination, clash detection using Navisworks and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), BIM execution planning, drawing production, and supporting construction administration deliverables. BIM / Production specialists are not discipline engineers — they are modeling and documentation experts who translate engineering intent into precise, coordinated construction documents. You will work across multiple projects and disciplines simultaneously, maintaining model health and supporting engineering teams in delivering high-quality work on schedule.

    At more senior levels, you will lead BIM strategy across projects, establish modeling standards, mentor junior production staff, and serve as the production quality authority on complex engagements.

What We're Looking For

    We hire at all levels — the strongest BIM candidates take ownership of model quality, stay curious about better workflows, and catch problems before they become field issues. If you don’t have everything on this list yet, that’s expected — TEECOM develops people through structured documentation, mentorship, and real project work.

    • Revit proficiency for MEP or technology systems documentation
    • Experience with Navisworks and/or Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) for coordination and clash detection
    • Ability to read and interpret technology systems design intent and translate it into coordinated Revit models
    • Understanding of BIM execution planning, model organization, worksets, view templates, and naming conventions
    • Experience working on complex projects across a range of facility types and industries
    • Degree in BIM, architecture, construction management, engineering technology, any four-year engineering discipline, or a related technical field — preferred
    • Familiarity with technology disciplines (ICT/Telecom, AV, Security, Wireless) — preferred
    • Autodesk Certified Professional: Revit MEP or equivalent Autodesk certification — preferred
    • Ability to manage your own work independently across multiple concurrent projects

      • *TEECOM covers exam fees and study materials for certifications relevant to your discipline, pays a one-time bonus when you pass, and funds all continuing education — including conference attendance.

TEECOM is a fully remote consulting firm. We hire across all US states, the UK, and India. Our projects span the globe — some roles involve international travel, so share your comfort level with your recruiter.

If you're ready to be assessed on your own merits and matched to the right team, apply here.

Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O’Brien, is seeking an experienced BIM/VDC Specialist for a long-term independent contractor basis.

This is an ongoing contractual engagement with a US-based company and is not limited to a single project. The role involves continuous collaboration across multiple mission-critical projects, based on business needs.
You will provide services as an independent, self-employed professional under a formal independent contractor agreement.

How to Apply: Interested candidates should submit their resume in English detailing their relevant experience.

Role Summary:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically skilled BIM/VDC Specialist an independent contract worker to support the coordination and delivery of large-scale data center projects across the U.S. In this role, you will be responsible for developing intelligent 3D models, coordinating design information across disciplines, and facilitating the integration of virtual design and construction processes into engineering workflows. You will collaborate closely with engineers, architects, and project managers throughout the project lifecycle—from concept design to construction documentation and digital handover. Proficiency in BIM tools (especially Autodesk Revit), understanding of data-driven modeling, and a collaborative mindset are essential.

What We Offer:

  • Unique, cutting-edge data center projects
  • Dynamic work partnering with a team of professionals focused on engineering
  • Competitive hourly rate
  • Ability to collaborate remotely
  • Supportive dynamic environment
  • English classes made available.

Key Responsibilities:

  • BIM coordination and model development across electrical, mechanical, architectural, and structural disciplines
  • Implementation and support VDC workflows, ensuring integration with project objectives and schedules
  • Work with Revit families, templates, and BIM content to ensure consistency across projects
  • Generation of clash detection reports using Revizto or Navisworks and participate in coordination meetings
  • Maintenance of accurate models and documentation throughout design and construction phases
  • Assistance with drawing production and model-based take-offs
  • Work with automation tools to streamline repetitive modeling tasks
  • Contribution to company BIM standards and process improvements

Qualifications & Experience:

  • A bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience in BIM/VDC roles, preferably in the data center, commercial, or industrial sectors
  • Proficiency with Autodesk Revit is essential. Experience with Revizto or Navisworks, BIM 360 is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with construction documentation, detailing, and coordination principles
  • Understanding of building systems (MEP) and construction sequencing
  • English proficiency (B1 level or higher)
  • Knowledge of design and engineering collaboration workflows
  • Ability to work independently and in cross-disciplinary teams
  • Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Passion for digital design, innovation, and continuous improvement

Why Us?

  • Perform on high-profile, hyperscale, and AI data center projects in a rapidly expanding industry
  • Collaborate with leading professionals and global clients such as Microsoft, Oracle, Uber, and Amazon
  • Competitive terms of the contract
  • Dynamic environment fostering creativity through exposure to advanced technologies such as BIM, VDC, digital twins, and augmented reality

Collaborate with Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O’Brien, and help us achieve our international engineering goals!

Our projects involve complex electrical, mechanical, automation, and security systems necessary to power, cool, and secure these high-demand facilities, often exceeding loads of 100 MW per facility and up to 500 MW per site.

We are recognized for our advanced engineering and construction techniques, including Building Information Modeling (BIM), Virtual Design and Construction (VDC), and augmented reality.

For more information, visit www.ehvert.com and www.salasobrien.com.

Job description

Exodigo is seeking a Senior 3D BIM Modeler to support the development and delivery of complex, data-rich infrastructure projects. This is a hands-on technical role for someone who combines strong Civil 3D and Bentley OpenRoads Designer (ORD) skills with excellent communication, attention to detail, and a strong commitment to quality.

You’ll develop and coordinate 3D models and engineering drawings, perform detailed QC, and work closely with project managers, engineers, and clients to communicate technical questions, issues, and recommendations.

What You’ll Do

  • Improve & Support: Contribute to CAD/BIM standards, templates, QC procedures, and workflows across Autodesk and Bentley environments. Provide technical support and guidance to other modelers and designers.
  • Model & Coordinate: Develop and coordinate 3D models and engineering drawings using Civil 3D, OpenRoads Designer (ORD), and MicroStation. Integrate survey, LiDAR, reality capture, GIS, design, and SUE data into accurate, coordinated deliverables.
  • QC & Problem Solve: Review drawings, models, surfaces, utility mapping, and project data to identify discrepancies, errors, and coordination issues. Apply sound technical judgment to resolve problems and ensure high-quality client deliverables.
  • Communicate & Collaborate: Work with project managers, engineers, and clients to clearly explain technical information, modeling challenges, QC findings, and recommended solutions. Support project teams from data development through final delivery.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in CAD/BIM, civil design, surveying, utility mapping, or related infrastructure disciplines.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Civil 3D and/or OpenRoads Designer (ORD); experience with both is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of 3D modeling, engineering drawings, construction documents, survey, surfaces, alignments, profiles, corridors, and utility data.
  • Excellent QA/QC and attention-to-detail skills with the ability to identify and communicate technical issues.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and confidence working directly with clients and technical teams.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across engineering, project management, CAD/BIM, GIS, and field teams.

Nice to Have

  • SUE, utility mapping, or civil engineering experience.
  • Experience with MicroStation, OpenBuildings Designer, ProjectWise, ACC, Revit, Navisworks, or ArcGIS Pro.
  • Experience with LiDAR, point clouds, reality capture, GIS, or subsurface mapping.
  • Experience developing CAD/BIM standards, templates, workflows, or QC procedures.
  • Familiarity with Python, Dynamo, or Bentley SDK for automation and workflow improvement.
